steps.code: <?php require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php'; global $wpdb; $old_url = 'https://lumina.nichewp.com'; $new_url = untrailingslashit(site_url()); $wpdb->query($wpdb->prepare("UPDATE {$wpdb->posts} SET post_content = REPLACE(post_content, %s, %s), guid = REPLACE(guid, %s, %s)", $old_url, $new_url, $old_url, $new_url)); $wpdb->query($wpdb->prepare("UPDATE {$wpdb->postmeta} SET meta_value = REPLACE(meta_value, %s, %s) WHERE meta_value LIKE %s", $old_url, $new_url, '%' . $wpdb->esc_like($old_url) . '%')); $wpdb->query($wpdb->prepare("UPDATE {$wpdb->options} SET option_value = REPLACE(option_value, %s, %s) WHERE option_name NOT IN ('siteurl', 'home') AND option_value LIKE %s", $old_url, $new_url, '%' . $wpdb->esc_like($old_url) . '%')); $home = get_page_by_path('home') ?: get_page_by_path('page-home') ?: get_page_by_title('Home'); $blog = get_page_by_path('blog') ?: get_page_by_path('news') ?: get_page_by_title('Blog'); if ($home) { update_option('show_on_front', 'page'); update_option('page_on_front', $home->ID); } if ($blog) { update_option('page_for_posts', $blog->ID); } global $wp_rewrite; $wp_rewrite->set_permalink_structure('/%postname%/'); flush_rewrite_rules(); ?>
